PRO-LONG reproduction: why the result is setup-blocked

PRO-LONG gives a game-playing coding agent a complete structured history and lets it retrieve old evidence with grep and Python. This notebook explains the claim, the matched test, the Kubernetes evidence, and why no scientific comparison can be made from this attempt. Verdict: not reproduced; both claims are unassessed. The public ARC-AGI-3 credential was absent in every corrected job, so zero fresh episodes ran.

## Primary evidence

| Condition | Planned episodes | Fresh episodes executed | Job duration |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Full log | 3 | **0** | 68s |
| Last 25 | 3 | 0 | 68s | | No log | 3 | 0 | 63s | | Stateless | 3 | 0 | 52s | 
Every terminal log names the same gate: `ARC_API_KEY not set`. The
planned workload was `g50t`, `m0r0`, and `ls20`, 120 actions each,
GPT-5.4 Codex, high reasoning, action cap 20, and three analyzer retries.

What would have been compared

The paper reports 41.2% pass@1 for full-log GPT-5.5 and 24.0% for no-log. Its tool ladder is 23.1 → 27.2 → 38.3 → 41.2% as read, grep, Python, and write/edit are added. These are paper numbers, not observations from this attempt. Zero episodes means there is no denominator for score, levels, tokens, analyzer calls, or retrieval efficiency.

Released-log audit: useful, but not a reproduction

The pinned release contains 25 scorecards, 25 trajectories, and 25 analyzer logs. Their official mean score is 94.7115 across 179 levels and 11,156 actions. Analyzer text includes 481 grep/regex, 3,210 Python, and 3,271 logs.txt mentions. This confirms artifact completeness and visible programmatic retrieval. It cannot test matched controls or token efficiency because it reuses author trajectories.

Compute and the executable next step

OpenResearch Kubernetes was used on an NVIDIA RTX PRO 6000 Blackwell cluster. The workload is API-driven, so peak GPU allocation was 0; four CPU jobs ran concurrently. Campaign wall time was 222 seconds (0.0617 hours). The runtime is ready: Python 3.12.13, Node 22.17.1, and Codex CLI 0.145.0 were printed in the successful logs, and OpenAI credentials were present. Adding ARC_API_KEY to the Kubernetes environment activates the four committed conditions without changing their fixed run command.
